subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The CEO along with his deputies (1)/ were present during the final negotiations (2)/ with the investors (3)/ and regulators. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is **“The CEO”**, which is **singular**.
 
• The phrase **“along with his deputies”** is a parenthetical phrase and does not change the number of the subject.
 
• The verb **“were”** is plural and** does not** agree with the **singular subject.**
 
• The correct verb should be **“was”** to maintain subject-verb agreement.

Correct sentence: *The CEO along with his deputies **was present** during the final negotiations with the investors and regulators.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Expressions like **along with, together with, as well as** do not affect subject-verb agreement.
 
• The verb always agrees with the **main subject**, not with the accompanying phrase.
 
• Example: The manager along with his team **is** attending the meeting.
